items.stem:

items.stem:
Read the revision note prepared by a Class 10 student on "Case studies of Belgium and Sri Lanka" and answer the questions that follow.
"In (A) ______ an Act was passed recognising Sinhala as the only official language of Sri Lanka. About 40 per cent of Belgians live in Wallonia and speak (B) ______."
(i) Fill in blank (A). (1 mark)
(ii) Fill in blank (B). (1 mark)
(iii) Why did Sri Lankan Tamils feel alienated after 1956? (2 marks)
items.answer: (i) 1956 (ii) French (iii) (1) Sinhala was made the only official language and Buddhism was given special protection. (2) Sinhala applicants were favoured for university positions and government jobs.

items.stem:
Read the revision note prepared by a Class 10 student on "Why power-sharing is desirable" and answer the questions that follow.
"In a democracy, people have a right to be (A) ______ on how they are to be governed. Reasons for power-sharing that stress careful calculation of gains and losses are called (B) ______ reasons."
(i) Fill in blank (A). (1 mark)
(ii) Fill in blank (B). (1 mark)
(iii) Why is power-sharing called the very spirit of democracy? (2 marks)
items.answer: (i) consulted (ii) prudential (iii) (1) A democratic rule involves sharing power with those affected by its exercise. (2) Citizens have a right to be consulted on how they are governed.
items.markingKey: (i) consulted – 1 mark. (ii) prudential – 1 mark. (iii) any two points, 1 mark each: (1) A democratic rule involves sharing power with those affected by its exercise. (2) Citizens have a right to be consulted on how they are governed.
